_comment: Lead-maintained. build_status.py merges this with live training data into status.json. Public: no paths, emails or node names.

project.title: Hand-contact-conditioned egocentric video generation
project.one_liner: Wan2.1-Fun-1.3B-InP + a ControlNet-style adapter that follows MANO hand trajectories and per-vertex contact (Motion Prompting recipe, adapted to hands).
project.deadline_note: First-results target was Nov 13; it slipped because training only started on Nov 13. Final Phase 1 numbers expected around Nov 14 evening.

stages.name: Interface spec
stages.detail: docs/interface.md v1 approved: 512x512, 49 frames @ 16 fps, MANO + per-vertex contact (vid-haco convention).

stages.name: Data
stages.detail: 3,032 HOT3D windows (2,728 train / 304 held-out participant P0015), outcome prompts, latent cache. Tests 16/16.

stages.name: Model + smoke tests
stages.detail: Adapter = trainable copy of the first 8 DiT blocks, zero-init. Overfit test: conditioning signal grows; resume check cut off by time limit (re-checked by the step-83 resume).

stages.name: Eval harness
stages.detail: HaMeR/HACO hand metrics + Qwen2.5-VL outcome checklist. Scores real video and the base model.

stages.name: Full training (2 runs)
stages.detail: v1_K8 (hand/contact-weighted loss) vs v1_K8_plain (plain loss), 10k steps each on 3 GPUs.

stages.name: Checkpoint evals
stages.detail: 2.5k / 5k / 7.5k / 10k, 32 held-out clips x 1 seed per run. Stop rule at 5k.

stages.name: Phase 1 report
stages.detail: Best checkpoint x 3 seeds vs base model and real video; sample videos.

stages.name: Phase 2: robot hands
stages.detail: Format reserved in interface.md section 6; data source not chosen yet.

needs_input.title: Turn on GitHub Pages
needs_input.detail: Repo elvishh77/3dvision -> Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from a branch -> main / (root). The site then appears at elvishh77.github.io/3dvision/.

needs_input.title: Optional: partition for checkpoint evals
needs_input.detail: Default is the shared gpu partition (1 GPU, ~45 min per checkpoint per seed). Say if 1-GPU eval jobs may use culbertson instead.

needs_input.title: Paper page: title and authors
needs_input.detail: The paper-style page uses a working title and 'Authors TBD'. Send the title and author list when ready.

blockers.title: Training is waiting for GPUs
blockers.detail: Both runs are queued on the shared gpu partition (A6000 or 6000 Ada allowed). Every hour in the queue moves every ETA by an hour.

blockers.title: 4-GPU runs hang at the first all-reduce
blockers.detail: Worked around by training on 3 GPUs per run. Not investigated further.

blockers.title: Idle-hand VLM metric is unreliable
blockers.detail: Says an idle hand holds an object 24% of the time on real video; reported as a side number only.

team.detail: Monitoring both training runs; respawns critic-evaluator at step 2,200.
Respawns about 30 min before the 2.5k checkpoint to score both runs and judge the stop rule.
Respawned only if a run fails or the stop rule fires at 5k.
All data work done; not needed for the rest of Phase 1.

next_actions: Step 2,500: score both runs; stop rule check (held-out gain > 0 and rising).
Step 5,000: go / no-go (stop and debug if held-out gain <= 0).
Step 10,000: pick best checkpoint by capped hand error; 3-seed final eval; Phase 1 report.

decisions.text: Training moved off culbertson to the shared gpu partition; A6000 allowed alongside 6000 Ada.
Plain-loss comparison run v1_K8_plain launched next to the weighted run.
Loss: hand weight 1, contact weight 2, with a stop rule at 5k steps.
Metrics: capped hand-keypoint error selects checkpoints; PCK@25, HACO contact F1, jitter and a Qwen2.5-VL outcome checklist are reported.
Base model Wan2.1-Fun-V1.1-1.3B-InP; 512x512, 49 frames @ 16 fps; human hands only in Phase 1.

iteration_note: Iteration = both 10k-step runs + final eval (10k checkpoints, then 3 seeds of the best) + report.
